name: Map the role/carrier seam in acp CLI, holder worker-event delivery and sideagent notice paths
details: Mapped scripts/kaola-acp.py _command_start_seat argv, scripts/kaola-acp-holder.py _deliver_worker_events/_heartbeat_payload/_worker_notice_payload, and the separate sideagent _node_prompt (kaola-sideagent-relay/1). Output landed on workflow/issue-388 in the implementation and tests.

name: Implement Host-only carrier: omit --host-entry for non-Host starts and guard holder delivery by session_role
details: kaola-acp.py computes the role before holder argv and passes --host-entry only for session_role=host; the holder parser default is empty so omitted means entry-less, while direct Holder construction keeps the legacy ZCode fallback. _deliver_worker_events requires host_entry and session_role==host, so worker/expert/sideagent get _worker_notice_payload; the sideagent node batch is unchanged. Output landed on workflow/issue-388 in scripts/kaola-acp.py and scripts/kaola-acp-holder.py (commit f46e1d4e).

name: Add contract tests for dsh/devin worker/expert notice vs Host carrier and no --host-entry on non-Host starts
details: tests/contract/test-issue-388-role-carrier.py covers dsh/devin worker+expert payloads with and without legacy host_entry, Host carrier control, sideagent node batch, and real dsh/devin starts asserting --host-entry absent from a non-Host holder argv and present for a Host. Existing 90/255/zcode-heartbeat fixtures now declare the Host role/name they intend. Registered in validate.sh lane B. Output landed on workflow/issue-388 (commit f46e1d4e).
